items.label: SUPERTRUX
items.problem: its header says 3,584 bytes and the block holds 512
items.why: KERNAL-format bootstrap used to start the Novaload chain.

items.label: turbo block 1 "NOVA"
items.why: Novaload setup and the program that requests tape blocks 1 through 8.

items.label: pulses 65593-68806
items.problem: 3,214 pulses in a format the kit does not decode, most of them 288 or 296 cycles long
items.why: Each stretch starts with a shifted echo of the preceding Novaload payload checksum and includes at least 1,975 consecutive short pilot pulses. The loader requests the ten recognized turbo blocks through its two setup loads and numbered loads 1–8.
